prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity full desktop application screen for Cultural Atlas, a consumer cultural discovery app. This is a visual design guide for engineers. One flat screenshot, no device frame, no surrounding presentation board. Landscape 1536x1024 or similar. Warm ivory background #F8F6F1, ink #252823, muted #72756C, olive accent #566347. Typography: elegant restrained editorial serif heading, modern sans UI. Crisp readable native-looking interface; generous whitespace, simple implementable HTML/CSS. Header wordmark "Cultural Atlas", navigation "Discover" active, "Collections", "Plans", right olive "+ Capture" button. Heading "Find more of what you love." Small filter row "All" active, "Wear", "Play", "Watch", "Eat". Below a beautiful four-column staggered visual discovery grid filling the screen with 8 image-led items in bounded varying aspect ratios. Photographic subjects: vintage racing jacket, sunlit wood-and-paper interior, jazz vinyl still life, colorful dinner, cinematic night street, sculptural chair, linen outfit, tea table. Short titles beneath each image, e.g. "Vintage racing", "Quiet corners", "Sunday listening", "Around the table". Small Save button on each image top right. Rounded image corners 16px, no heavy card borders, no shadows. Editorial, tactile and welcoming, specific consumer app not marketing landing page. No technical data, cultural graphs, scores, AI labels, sources, dashboards, follower counts, public sharing, search bar, or term boards. No hero eyebrow. Photography has natural color, no tint overlay. Text and controls must be readable. This is concept artwork, not a screenshot with working UI.
